title: Can I make this upgrade in one step?

scenes.heading: Can this upgrade happen in one hop?
scenes.sub: Check before applying the new bundle
voice: A new recipe changes several components in your running stack.
Before applying it, check the path from what is deployed now to the specific recipe you want.

scenes.heading: Identify what is deployed
scenes.sub: Use the bundle or live release records
voice: Use a saved bundle when it reflects the installed stack.
You can also tell AICR to read live release records for the selected deployer and compare those with the target recipe.

scenes.heading: One component blocks the direct move
voice: The report marks each component safe, manual, blocked, or unknown.
Here, one transition is blocked and the guidance identifies an intermediate release to assess before you move.

scenes.heading: Assess the next move separately
voice: Run upgrade check for the intermediate target and follow any required steps.
When you reach it, rerun the assessment before handing the next bundle to your deployment tool.

viewer: Operator planning a GPU stack upgrade
payoff: Compare the deployed stack with a proposed recipe and use a blocked transition to decide what to assess separately.
